description: Shelf-mark probe set (170 probes) with the reference columns of the 2026-11-02 normaliser audit. REF_canonical_id = institution_tokens.canonical_id(institution, mark); REF_core = ShelfmarkNormalizer.to_canonical_id(mark); REF_loose_key = ShelfmarkNormalizer.loose_key(REF_core); REF_token = institution_tokens.institution_token(institution); REF_loose_of_cid = ShelfmarkNormalizer.loose_key(REF_canonical_id); REF_cudl = cudl_manifest(mark) with the PGP fragment list (only the entries in cudl_known_fragments matter for these probes). expected_es_id = the id the item should carry in the primary ES index (null where no single item is named); expected_in_es = whether the ES held that id on 2026-11-02 (null without an expected id). Six probes (P124-P129) were substituted for a holdings-policy reason; their reference columns were computed with the same recipe.
